en.hero.description: QuantCell is an AI-native quantitative trading system powered by the axon-quant Rust engine, with FastAPI and React/TypeScript. Describe strategies in natural language — AI generates the code, passes safety checks, and completes backtest verification, from idea to live deployment.
en.hero.badge.rust.title: Rust Core Engine
en.hero.badge.cli.title: CLI Toolkit
en.features.title: Everything for AI-Native Quant Trading
en.features.subtitle: From natural-language strategy ideas to Rust-powered backtesting and live deployment
en.features.nlgen.title: Natural-Language Strategy Generation
en.features.nlgen.description: Describe a trading idea in plain language and get executable strategy code automatically. Thinking-chain reasoning is explainable and traceable, with built-in code quality and safety checks.
en.features.agent.title: AI Agent
en.features.agent.description: An AI agent with long-term memory, tool calling, and built-in skills (news analysis, technical analysis) for multi-turn conversations and operation orchestration.
en.features.indicator.title: Custom Indicators with AI
en.features.indicator.description: Write indicator code in the browser; the LLM diagnoses errors in the code and fixes them automatically.
en.features.backtest.title: Event-Driven Backtesting
en.features.backtest.description: Powered by the axon-quant Rust core, with K-line, Tick, OrderBook, and Deriv data adapters. Backtests and live trading share identical matching semantics, guarded by conformance contract tests.
en.features.hpo.title: Walk-Forward & Hyperparameter Optimization
en.features.hpo.description: Rolling-window validation prevents overfitting. Built-in Optuna HPO with TPE sampling and median pruning.
en.features.rl.title: Reinforcement Learning
en.features.rl.description: Gymnasium trading environments with Stable-Baselines3 (PPO / SAC / DQN), covering the full train → backtest → evaluate → retrain lifecycle.
en.features.exchange.title: Unified Exchange Access
en.features.exchange.description: Binance (live / paper / archive) and OKX adapters, with WebSocket real-time streaming, automatic reconnection, and persistence.
en.features.data.title: DuckDB + Parquet Data Stack
en.features.data.description: Columnar storage for efficient reads and writes, plus data quality checks, automatic gap recovery, and archive repair for corrupted files.
en.features.worker.title: Worker Live Execution
en.features.worker.description: Strategy live loops, paper trading, and engine deployment with full lifecycle management.
en.features.plugin.title: Plugin System
en.features.plugin.description: Inter-plugin communication through a unified event bus and isolation in a security sandbox. Package and install plugins with one quantcell plugin command.
en.features.risk.title: Risk Control & Credential Security
en.features.risk.description: Exchange API keys are encrypted at rest and managed via quantcell account, with a risk engine for monitoring and unified JWT authentication.
en.features.frontend.title: Modern Frontend & Visualization
en.features.frontend.description: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite 7 + Ant Design 6, KLineCharts/ECharts, the Monaco editor, backtest replay, and built-in zh/en i18n.
en.architecture.title: System Architecture
en.architecture.description: React/TypeScript on the frontend, FastAPI services, and the axon-quant Rust trading core — decoupled through axon_bridge, covering strategy development, backtest validation, and live deployment.
en.architecture.points.engine.title: Rust Core Engine
en.architecture.points.engine.description: Identical matching semantics in backtest and live trading; conformance contract tests protect every engine upgrade.
en.architecture.points.ai.title: AI-Native Loop
en.architecture.points.ai.description: Natural language → code generation → safety checks → backtest verification → deployment.
en.architecture.points.bridge.title: axon_bridge Decoupling
en.architecture.points.bridge.description: The Python business layer and the Rust engine stay decoupled — one strategy codebase runs in both backtests and live trading.
en.quickstart.title: Get Running in Minutes
en.quickstart.subtitle: Three steps from clone to your first AI-generated, backtested strategy
en.quickstart.step1.title: Install with one command
en.quickstart.step1.description: Clone the repo and run the installer. It provisions the uv and bun toolchains plus the frontend and backend environments (--minimal / --full / --extra).
en.quickstart.step2.title: Generate and backtest via CLI
en.quickstart.step2.description: Turn a natural-language requirement into a strategy, then run an event-driven backtest with a single command.
en.quickstart.step3.title: Write strategies in Python
en.quickstart.step3.description: Receive bars in on_bar and return a unified axon_quant Action. The same code runs in backtests and live trading.
en.opensource.title: Open Source & Community
en.opensource.description: QuantCell is open source under Apache 2.0. Explore the code, try the live demo, or reach out directly.
en.footer.description: An AI-native quantitative trading system — making quant trading simpler, faster, and smarter.

zh.hero.badge: AI 原生量化交易系统
zh.hero.title1: 用自然语言构建、回测和部署
zh.hero.description: QuantCell 是 AI 原生量化交易系统，以 axon-quant（Rust 核心）为交易引擎，FastAPI + React/TypeScript 为前后端。用自然语言描述策略，AI 自动生成代码、完成安全校验与回测验证，覆盖从想法到实盘部署的全流程。
zh.hero.badge.rust.title: Rust 核心引擎
zh.hero.badge.cli.title: 命令行工具
zh.features.title: AI 原生量化交易的完整能力
zh.features.subtitle: 从自然语言策略想法，到 Rust 引擎回测与实盘部署
zh.features.nlgen.title: 自然语言策略生成
zh.features.nlgen.description: 用自然语言描述交易想法，自动生成可执行策略代码；思维链推理可解释、可追溯，并内置代码质量与安全自检。
zh.features.agent.title: AI 智能体
zh.features.agent.description: 具备长期记忆、工具调用与内置技能（新闻分析、技术分析）的 AI Agent，支持多轮对话与操作编排。
zh.features.indicator.title: 自定义指标 · AI 辅助
zh.features.indicator.description: 在浏览器中编写指标代码，LLM 自动诊断代码中的错误并完成修复。
zh.features.backtest.title: 事件驱动高性能回测
zh.features.backtest.description: axon-quant Rust 核心驱动，支持 K 线、Tick、OrderBook、Deriv 多数据适配器；回测与实盘采用一致撮合语义，并有 conformance 契约测试守护。
zh.features.hpo.title: Walk-Forward 与超参优化
zh.features.hpo.description: 滚动窗口验证防止过拟合；内置 Optuna 超参优化，采用 TPE 采样与中位数剪枝。
zh.features.rl.title: 强化学习
zh.features.rl.description: 基于 Gymnasium 量化环境与 Stable-Baselines3（PPO / SAC / DQN），覆盖训练 → 回测 → 评估 → 重训完整生命周期。
zh.features.exchange.title: 多交易所统一接入
zh.features.exchange.description: Binance（实盘 / 纸面 / 归档）与 OKX 适配器，支持 WebSocket 实时订阅、自动重连与持久化。
zh.features.data.title: DuckDB + Parquet 数据生态
zh.features.data.description: 列式存储高效读写，配套数据质量检测、缺失自动回补与损坏文件归档修复。
zh.features.worker.title: Worker 实盘执行
zh.features.worker.description: 策略实盘循环、纸面交易与引擎部署，提供完整的生命周期管理。
zh.features.plugin.title: 插件系统
zh.features.plugin.description: 插件间通过统一事件总线通信，并在安全沙箱中隔离运行；一条 quantcell plugin 命令即可打包安装。
zh.features.risk.title: 风控与凭证安全
zh.features.risk.description: 交易所 API 密钥加密入库，通过 quantcell account 统一管理；配套风险引擎监控与 JWT 统一鉴权。
zh.features.frontend.title: 现代化前端与可视化
zh.features.frontend.description: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite 7 + Ant Design 6，KLineCharts/ECharts 专业图表、Monaco 编辑器、回测回放与中英 i18n。
zh.architecture.title: 系统架构
zh.architecture.description: 前端 React/TypeScript、服务 FastAPI、交易内核 axon-quant（Rust），通过 axon_bridge 解耦，覆盖策略开发、回测验证到实盘部署的全流程。
zh.architecture.points.engine.title: Rust 核心引擎
zh.architecture.points.engine.description: 回测与实盘采用一致撮合语义；conformance 契约测试守护每一次引擎升级。
zh.architecture.points.ai.title: AI 原生闭环
zh.architecture.points.ai.description: 自然语言 → 代码生成 → 安全校验 → 回测验证 → 部署上线。
zh.architecture.points.bridge.title: axon_bridge 桥接
zh.architecture.points.bridge.description: Python 业务层与 Rust 引擎解耦，一套策略代码即可回测、也可实盘。
zh.quickstart.title: 三步上手
zh.quickstart.subtitle: 从克隆仓库到完成第一个 AI 生成并回测的策略，只需三步
zh.quickstart.step1.title: 一键安装
zh.quickstart.step1.description: 克隆仓库并运行安装脚本，自动配置 uv、bun 工具链与前后端环境（--minimal / --full / --extra）。
zh.quickstart.step2.title: CLI 生成策略并回测
zh.quickstart.step2.description: 把自然语言需求变成策略，再用一条命令完成事件驱动回测。
zh.quickstart.step3.title: 用 Python 编写策略
zh.quickstart.step3.description: 在 on_bar 中接收 K 线、返回 axon_quant 统一 Action，同一套代码可回测、可实盘。

zh.opensource.description: QuantCell 基于 Apache 2.0 协议开源。查看源码、体验在线 Demo，或直接与作者联系。
